findings: The pre-polish dual-agent critique scored 20/28 applicable points and found three P1 issues: a discontinuous Life Room, a misleading beta CTA state, and repetitive feature pacing. The preserve pass resolved all three before finish review.

The final dual-agent finish review passed at 33/40 design and 17/20 technical quality with zero P0/P1. Follow-up polish aligned beta copy, lazy-loaded below-fold captures, reduced the shared mark from 372 KiB to targeted 4 KiB and 44 KiB renditions, and enlarged secondary touch targets.
Current 390, 768, and 1440 browser evidence was regenerated after the final source changes using real scroll behavior so lazy-loaded app captures are present.
The bundled Impeccable detector returned an empty finding list after the web scene tokens and geometry were documented in DESIGN.md.

The remaining mobile-length observation is a P2 pacing tradeoff: all four real product spaces remain visible because feature parity and truthful product proof are part of the approved launch scope. Red controls inside owned app screenshots are a non-blocking P3 artifact of real product evidence.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner explicitly requested a super-beautiful landing and delegated implementation judgment after approving the Indulge preparation direction. The selected Life Room preserves the established app world, and the final independent review clears the required 32/40 design and 16/20 audit floors with zero unresolved P0/P1.
